subproblem.title: Bound at a fixed radius: |∫_{M∩B_t} θ⟨dβ, ξ⟩ dHⁿ| ≤ s·liminf_{h→0+} h⁻¹μ{t − h < |x| < t} for every t < R
subproblem.statement:
Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and Rp = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity representation of S in U (IMRep U n with Rp.Represents S, Hⁿ = μHE[n]). Let R, t ∈ ℝ with closedBall(0, R) ⊆ U and t < R, and assume ∂S(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ B_R(0) (open ball). Then for every β ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ m) and every s ∈ ℝ with |β(x)| ≤ s for all x (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm), in [0, ∞]:
  ENNReal.ofReal |∫_{M ∩ B_t(0)} θ(x)·⟨dβ(x), ξ(x)⟩ dHⁿ(x)| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(s) · liminf_{h→0+} ENNReal.ofReal(h⁻¹)·μ({x : t − h < ‖x‖ < t}),
where μ = Rp.measure = (Hⁿ⌞M).withDensity θ, d = exteriorDerivative, ⟨dβ(x), ξ(x)⟩ = Rp.orient x (dβ x), and the liminf is taken along the filter 𝓝[>] 0.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Rp : IMRep U (m + 1)) (R t : ℝ), closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ U → Rp.Represents S → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 R → S.boundary ω = 0) → t < R → ∀ (β : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (s : ℝ), (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ≤ s) → ENNReal.ofReal |∫ x in Rp.carrier ∩ ball 0 t, (Rp.mult x : ℝ) * Rp.orient x (exteriorDerivative (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂μHE[m + 1]| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s * liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * Rp.measure {x : Euclid P | t - h < ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ < t}) (𝓝[>] 0)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 1, 3 and 4 of the parent proof, i.e. Simon Ch. 6, 4.9–4.11 for the 1-Lipschitz function f(y) = |y| (chapter-06.txt lines 1335–1403). The steps are: smooth cutoffs of the sublevel set {|y| < t}; the defect estimate coming from ∂S = 0 on B_R(0); and the passage h ↓ 0 of Simon 4.11. Departures from the parent proof (the argument is unchanged): the cutoffs g_h are those of the reused sibling level_cutoff (Simon's cutoff γ∘f, with ‖Dg_h‖ ≤ 1/(h(1 − h/2)) in place of 2L/h); the limit h ↓ 0 is taken along the filter 𝓝[>]0 by dominated convergence (reused sibling cutoff_integral_tendsto); and the liminf of the strip quotients is taken along 𝓝[>]0 (reused sibling liminf_bound), which removes the factor (1 − h/2)⁻¹ and needs no subsequence h = 1/k. Siblings used: cutoff_defect (new, Submission.dtc_bc_tc_rs_cutoff_defect), and the comparator-accepted declarations level_cutoff (Submission.cmcs_level_cutoff), cutoff_integral_tendsto (Submission.cmcs_smp_cutoff_integral_tendsto), liminf_bound (Submission.cmcs_smp_liminf_bound) and pairing_bound (Submission.dpf_pfc_imrep_pairing_integrable_abs_le), reused with identical frozen types.

Notation. n := m + 1; Hⁿ := μHE[n]; M := Rp.carrier, θ := Rp.mult, ξ := Rp.orient; μ := Rp.measure. b := β, viewed as an m-form, and db := exteriorDerivative b. For a covector α, |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α, and ‖α‖ is its operator norm (the ContinuousAlternatingMap norm, as in pairing_bound). Further:
- F₀(x) := θ(x)·ξ(x)(db(x));
- I := ∫_{M∩B_t(0)} F₀ dHⁿ;
- A_h := {x : t − h < ‖x‖ < t} and v(h) := μ(A_h);
- Λ := liminf_{h→0+} ofReal(h⁻¹)·v(h) ∈ [0, ∞], the liminf along 𝓝[>]0.
The claim is ofReal|I| ≤ ofReal(s)·Λ.

1. (s ≥ 0.) s ≥ |b(0)| ≥ 0 (covectorEuclideanNorm_nonneg).

2. (Case t ≤ 0.) Then B_t(0) = ∅ (Metric.ball_eq_empty), so I = 0 and ofReal|I| = 0 ≤ ofReal(s)·Λ. From now on assume t > 0.

3. (Cutoffs.) f(x) := ‖x‖ is 1-Lipschitz (lipschitzWith_one_norm). For each h ∈ (0, 1), apply the sibling level_cutoff to f, L = 1, t and h. It gives a C^∞ function g_h : ℝ^P → ℝ with
   (i) |g_h(x)| ≤ 2 for all x;
   (ii) ‖Dg_h(x)‖ ≤ 1/(h(1 − h/2)) for all x;
   (iii) Dg_h(x) ≠ 0 implies x ∈ A_h;
   (iv) g_h(x) = 1 if ‖x‖ ≤ t − h;
   (v) g_h(x) = 0 if ‖x‖ ≥ t.
   Fix such a choice g_h for every h ∈ (0, 1) (axiom of choice), and put g_h := 0 for all other h. This defines g : ℝ → (ℝ^P → ℝ).
   For h ∈ (0, 1), (v) gives support g_h ⊆ {‖x‖ < t} ⊆ closedBall(0, t). Since closedBall(0, t) is closed, tsupport g_h ⊆ closedBall(0, t). Since t < R, closedBall(0, t) ⊆ B_R(0) ⊆ closedBall(0, R) ⊆ U.

4. (The truncated integrand F is integrable.) Let C := closedBall(0, t). C is compact (isCompact_closedBall) and C ⊆ U.
   db is a test form (exteriorDerivative_isTestForm), hence continuous with compact support. So B := sup_x ‖db(x)‖ < ∞ (Continuous.bddAbove_range_of_hasCompactSupport).
   The covector field 1_C·db has the following properties: it is a.e. strongly measurable (a continuous field times the indicator of a measurable set); it vanishes off C; and ‖1_C(x)db(x)‖ ≤ B for all x.
   The sibling pairing_bound (with n = m + 1, this U, this C and F := 1_C·db) shows that x ↦ θ(x)ξ(x)(1_C(x)db(x)) is Hⁿ⌞M-integrable. Since ξ(x)(0) = 0, this function equals F := 1_C·F₀. So F is Hⁿ⌞M-integrable.

5. (The function Φ.) Put Φ(h) := ∫ g_h F d(Hⁿ⌞M) for every h ∈ ℝ. Let h ∈ (0, 1). For every x, g_h(x)F(x) = g_h(x)F₀(x): if x ∈ C both sides agree; if x ∉ C then ‖x‖ > t, so g_h(x) = 0 by (v) and both sides vanish. Hence, for h ∈ (0, 1),
   Φ(h) = ∫_M g_h(x)·(θ(x)ξ(x)(db(x))) dHⁿ(x).

6. (Strip estimate.) Let h ∈ (0, 1). Apply the sibling cutoff_defect with V := B_R(0), g := g_h and the given β. Its hypotheses hold: g_h is C^∞, tsupport g_h ⊆ U and tsupport g_h ⊆ B_R(0) by step 3, and its boundary hypothesis is exactly the hypothesis on S. By step 5 it gives
   ofReal|Φ(h)| ≤ ∫⁻ ofReal(‖Dg_h(x)‖·|b(x)|) dμ(x).
   Now bound the integrand at each x. If Dg_h(x) = 0 it is 0. Otherwise x ∈ A_h by (iii), and by (ii) and |b(x)| ≤ s, ‖Dg_h(x)‖·|b(x)| ≤ (1/(h(1 − h/2)))·s = s/(h(1 − h/2)). Thus ofReal(‖Dg_h(x)‖|b(x)|) ≤ 1_{A_h}(x)·ofReal(s/(h(1 − h/2))) for all x.
   A_h is open (preimage of an open interval under the continuous norm), hence measurable. By lintegral_mono and lintegral_indicator_const,
   ofReal|Φ(h)| ≤ ofReal(s/(h(1 − h/2)))·v(h)   for every h ∈ (0, 1).   (1)

7. (Limit h → 0+.) Apply the sibling cutoff_integral_tendsto with: the measure Hⁿ⌞M; the integrable F of step 4; the measurable f = ‖·‖ (measurable_norm); t; C = 2; and the family g of step 3. Its hypotheses hold: for h ∈ (0, 1), g_h is continuous (hence a.e. strongly measurable), |g_h| ≤ 2 by (i), g_h = 1 on {f ≤ t − h} by (iv), and g_h = 0 on {f ≥ t} by (v). It yields Φ(h) → ∫_{{x : ‖x‖ < t}} F d(Hⁿ⌞M) as h → 0+, along 𝓝[>]0.
   This limit equals I, for three reasons: {x : ‖x‖ < t} = B_t(0); (Hⁿ⌞M)⌞B_t(0) = Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ B_t(0)) (Measure.restrict_restrict and Set.inter_comm); and F = F₀ on B_t(0) ⊆ C (setIntegral_congr_fun).
   Hence Φ(h) → I, and |Φ(h)| → |I| (Tendsto.abs).

8. (liminf.) Apply the sibling liminf_bound with:
   - L := s, an element of [0, ∞) since s ≥ 0, so (L : ℝ) = s;
   - z := |I|;
   - the function h ↦ |Φ(h)|;
   - the function v.
   Its hypotheses are step 7 and (1); note ofReal||Φ(h)|| = ofReal|Φ(h)|. It gives ofReal|I| ≤ (L : [0, ∞])·Λ = ofReal(s)·Λ, which is the claim. ∎
proof_key_steps: The case t ≤ 0 is trivial (B_t(0) = ∅). For t > 0, take the C^∞ cutoffs g_h (0 < h < 1) of cmcs_level_cutoff for f = ‖·‖ and L = 1: g_h = 1 on {‖x‖ ≤ t − h}, g_h = 0 on {‖x‖ ≥ t}, ‖Dg_h‖ ≤ 1/(h(1 − h/2)), and Dg_h ≠ 0 only on the strip A_h = {t − h < ‖x‖ < t}. So tsupport g_h ⊆ closedBall(0, t) ⊆ B_R(0) ⊆ U.
cutoff_defect with V = B_R(0), plus the pointwise strip bound ‖Dg_h‖|β| ≤ (s/(h(1 − h/2)))·1_{A_h}, gives ofReal|∫_M g_h θ⟨dβ, ξ⟩| ≤ ofReal(s/(h(1 − h/2)))·μ(A_h).
F = 1_{closedBall(0,t)}·θ⟨dβ, ξ⟩ is Hⁿ⌞M-integrable (dpf_pfc_imrep_pairing_integrable_abs_le). cmcs_smp_cutoff_integral_tendsto then gives ∫ g_h F → ∫_{M∩B_t} θ⟨dβ, ξ⟩ dHⁿ as h → 0+.
cmcs_smp_liminf_bound with L = s turns the strip estimates into ofReal|∫_{M∩B_t} θ⟨dβ, ξ⟩| ≤ ofReal(s)·liminf_{h→0+} h⁻¹μ(A_h).

audit.reason: The proof covers t ≤ 0, establishes s ≥ 0, verifies cutoff supports and integrability, and applies dominated convergence and the liminf bound with their exact hypotheses. No openness or positivity hypothesis omitted from the type is needed.
